cover.roman: Google sends you 320 visits a month.
cover.italic: Eight of them become leads. The rest hit a homepage that talks about windows generally and a quote form behind three clicks.
cover.dek: Pella of Columbus runs four active Meta ads. Three of them land on /replacement-windows-quote, a page slower than the homepage with weaker tracking and the same form gate.

rankedFixes.what: Install GA4 via Google Tag Manager and wire the lead conversion event.
rankedFixes.why: Google Ads optimization is blind without GA4. Twenty minutes of work. Two days for the algorithm to start learning. The downstream conversion-rate work depends on this.

rankedFixes.what: Ship LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema on the homepage.
rankedFixes.why: Three fields, one block, fifteen minutes. Lets AI engines connect your domain to your address, service area, and phone. The cheapest AEO win available.

rankedFixes.what: Cut the ad LP load time from 4.2s to under 2.5s mobile.
rankedFixes.why: Every second of LP delay drops ad conversion roughly seven percent. You are losing 30-40% of paid traffic to the page weight before any copy fights for them.

personalObservation.text: I asked Perplexity who installs Pella windows in Columbus Ohio. Your site was not in the top five. Renewal by Andersen and Window World were. Pella's national site was. You are paying Meta to fight for clicks that Perplexity is giving away to your competitors for free. Fix the AEO and the GA4 gap first. The LP and the conversion-path work is downstream, if you cannot measure it, you cannot optimize it.
